probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A sensor system, comprising: a sensor device having an external surface on which is arranged at least one electrical test contact; and a cover device including at least partially an electrically insulating material, the cover device mechanically connected to the sensor device; wherein the cover device is configured to cover the at least one electrical test contact of the sensor device so as to prevent contact from being made to the at least one electrical test contact from outside the sensor system, __and wherein the cover device is configured to enable electrical contact to be made to at least one electrical connecting contact from outside the sensor system while the at least one electrical test contact remains covered by the cover device__.

2. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the cover device has an internal surface configured to face the external surface including the at least one test contact, and at least one further metallization is arranged on the internal surface, the at least one further metallization mechanically connected to the at least one electrical test contact, __the at least one further metallization being arranged such that the at least one electrical test contact is electrically contactable only via the at least one further metallization and not directly from outside the sensor system__.

3. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, further comprising: at least one electrical connecting contact arranged on the external surface including the at least one test contact, wherein the cover device is configured to enable electrical contact to be made to the at least one electrical connecting contact from outside the sensor system, __and wherein the at least one electrical connecting contact is separate from the at least one electrical test contact__.

4. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 3, wherein the cover device includes at least one of at least one first opening and at least one via electrically connected to the at least one electrical connecting contact to enable electrical contact to be made from outside the sensor system, __the at least one first opening and the at least one via being configured such that electrical contact from outside the sensor system is enabled to the at least one electrical connecting contact and prevented to the at least one electrical test contact__.

5. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the sensor device includes a sensor substrate configured to form the external surface including the at least one test contact, the cover device includes a cover substrate having a first segment corresponding to the external surface, and the first segment of the cover device and the external surface including the at least one test contact are connected together at least partially, __with the at least one electrical test contact located between the first segment and the external surface__.

6. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 5, wherein the cover device includes a second segment configured to bound the first segment and at least partially enclose the sensor device at right angles to the external surface.

10. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the sensor device and the cover device includes an integrated circuit.
